name: 21157 · Westminster, MD
findings: ZIP 21157 (Westminster) has 204 nonprofit organizations. 104 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 89 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21157 (Westminster) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 21157 (Westminster) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 89 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
